implementation_constraints: plain JavaScript, Node >= 18, no dependencies, CommonJS
reads one JSON value from stdin, prints one line, exits 0; module.exports + require.main guard

unresolved_intent.decision: reject with ERROR when the parsed top-level JSON value is null, an array, or any non-plain-object (e.g. number/string/bool), since the spec only allows a JSON object
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec says 'not a JSON object' is an error but JSON.parse(null-literal) also yields typeof 'object' in JS, so null must be excluded explicitly to avoid crashing on capacity/refill/events destructure

unresolved_intent.decision: use Number.isInteger to reject booleans, non-integral numbers, strings, and other non-number types for capacity/refill in one check, since typeof true !== 'number' already excludes booleans
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec explicitly calls out booleans and non-integral numbers as invalid; Number.isInteger combined with a typeof number guard covers both without a separate boolean check

unresolved_intent.decision: validate the entire events array (every element is exactly 'tick' or 'req') BEFORE processing any event, rather than validating and processing in the same pass
unresolved_intent.rationale: AC-RL-05 requires 'no partial log' on malformed input; a single-pass approach could emit partial log entries before hitting an invalid event, so validation is a separate upfront pass

unresolved_intent.decision: use console.log(JSON.stringify(result)) for compact single-line JSON output with no extra whitespace
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec states output formatting is not fixed, only structure/values matter, so the simplest compact serialization satisfies the contract

unresolved_intent.decision: treat JSON.parse failures (syntactically invalid JSON on stdin) the same as structurally malformed objects, printing ERROR
unresolved_intent.rationale: the spec's error list doesn't explicitly mention JSON parse failures, but 'input that is not a JSON object' is naturally read to include input that isn't valid JSON at all
